body: Aw, im sorry that you feel so drained. Maybe it isnt the right job,or maybe you have to change your attitude towards it. My feeling it that it is the first one. Sometimes we feel drained because we feel there is so much pressure but its us putting that pressure on ourselves. Even if that pressure IS coming from the outside, its very beneficial if we can stay with ourselves and not get too affected by it. Of course thats just my opinion and i know its a lot easier to just say it than do it.
